verdict.rationale: Buzz ships a Desktop-bundled managed agent with a packaged buzz-cli skill covering messaging, channels, workflows, repos, canvas, and memory. It also ships its own buzz-agent runtime, and users delegate by @mentioning agents in channels: the harness prompts the agent, which acts and replies through the relay. Documented agent actions include opening repos, sending patches, running workflows, and orchestrating other agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, and a turnkey built-in setup (agents need per-agent keypairs, enrollment, and a user-supplied LLM provider).
